scope: Room2 fixed-point reference only; not a light proposal or production table
layout: 853 x 1 RGBA32I little-endian int32: cube min x,y,z,material ID; sorted by min,material,mass
output: RGB = conditional direct linear sRGB Z_l without light PMF division; alpha = luminance(Z_l)^2. All zero outcomes retained. Full screen flattened row-major index: light=index%N, point=(index//N)%2; only first floor(width*height/(2*N))*2*N pixels used.
audit: First two records (4 vec4 each): origin/slot; normal/samples per light per frame; working-space albedo/receiver flag; raw pixel xy/light count/mode marker3. Audit writes are unique even when audit atomics off.
acceptance: Exact leaf/mass identity and topology must match source tree before/after acquisition; receiver origins/normals must match primary audit. Preserve nonfinite/incomplete samples and reference uncertainty.
